# Obsidian CSS Snippets

This directory contains custom CSS snippets for Obsidian.

## Installed Snippets

### toc-sidebar.css
Enhances the Table of Contents (ToC) sidebar and page preview:
- Better outline styling with hover effects
- Enhanced page preview popover
- Improved heading styles
- Table and code block styling
- Link hover effects

## Usage

1. Open Obsidian Settings
2. Go to Appearance → CSS Snippets
3. Enable "toc-sidebar.css"
4. Click the refresh button to reload

## Keyboard Shortcuts

| Action | Shortcut |
|--------|----------|
| Toggle Outline (ToC) | Alt+O |
| Toggle Page Preview | Alt+P |
| Open Graph View | Ctrl+Shift+G |
| Quick Switcher | Ctrl+O |
| Command Palette | Ctrl+Shift+P |
